comments.author: Edny_Tiago
comments.body: Saw someone wearing the Green Loincloth? Anyone know where to get it?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
It's a color-custom version produced with a recipe found at Candia's Craftsman; Mythical Era Chrono Title required before the recipe appears. There are others available at the same NPC, but let's stay on topic.

Skill/Rank: Sewing R7
Ingredients: Cotton fabric x10, Goldwork x3, Embroidery Thread x5

Stats:

+1 Food trading
6500 fame to equip, male-only, Black/Purple/Green. Different from the Dungeon drop and Item Shop versions which cannot be color-customized.

Source/pics: rabbilog.blog46.fc2.com/blog-entry-298.html

Cheers.
